title.rendered: Lorem Ipsum Generator: Free Placeholder Text Tool

content.rendered:
Generate Placeholder Text Instantly

Lorem Ipsum is the standard placeholder text used by designers, developers, and content creators worldwide. Instead of writing temporary text yourself or copying it from unreliable sources, use this generator to produce authentic Lorem Ipsum text in the exact format and quantity you need. Choose paragraphs, sentences, words, or list items, set the amount, and click Generate.

Everything runs in your browser. No sign-up, no server uploads, no limits. Copy as plain text for documents or as HTML with proper tags for web projects.

How to Use This Lorem Ipsum Generator

  1. Choose a format — select Paragraphs, Sentences, Words, or Lists from the dropdown.
  2. Set the amount — use the +/- buttons or type a number from 1 to 100.
  3. Toggle the classic start — enable to begin with the traditional “Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet…” opening.
  4. Click Generate — your placeholder text appears instantly with word and character counts.
  5. Copy or download — copy as plain text, copy as HTML with proper p and ul/li tags, or download as a .txt file.

What Is Lorem Ipsum?

Lorem Ipsum is dummy text that has been the typesetting industry’s standard placeholder since the 1500s. It is derived from sections 1.10.32 and 1.10.33 of “De Finibus Bonorum et Malorum” (On the Ends of Good and Evil) by Marcus Tullius Cicero, written in 45 BC. The text was scrambled and adapted to create a passage that looks like natural Latin text but is largely nonsensical.

The standard Lorem Ipsum passage has been used since the 1960s when Letraset released sheets containing Lorem Ipsum passages for use in typesetting. It was later popularized in the 1980s with desktop publishing software like Aldus PageMaker that included Lorem Ipsum as a built-in feature.

Why Use Lorem Ipsum?

  • Focuses attention on design — reviewers evaluate layout, typography, and spacing instead of reading the content.
  • Realistic text distribution — Lorem Ipsum has a natural distribution of letters and word lengths similar to English, making layouts look realistic.
  • Industry standard — recognized instantly by designers, developers, and clients as placeholder content.
  • Available in any quantity — generate exactly the amount you need, from a single word to 100 paragraphs.
  • Language neutral — works for mockups in any language since the placeholder is universally understood.

When to Use Lorem Ipsum

  • Website mockups and wireframes — fill page layouts with realistic text before content is written.
  • UI/UX prototypes — test how interfaces handle varying text lengths in buttons, cards, and forms.
  • Print design — fill brochures, flyers, posters, and magazine spreads during the design phase.
  • Presentations — create realistic slide layouts before final copy is approved.
  • Email templates — test how email clients render different text volumes.
  • Theme development — populate WordPress themes, Shopify themes, and other CMS templates with sample content.

Lorem Ipsum vs. Alternatives

While alternatives like Hipster Ipsum, Bacon Ipsum, and Cupcake Ipsum exist as humorous variations, traditional Lorem Ipsum remains the professional standard for several reasons. It does not distract with jokes or culturally specific references. It has been tested in countless layouts over decades. And it is immediately recognized as placeholder content by anyone in the design or development industry. For professional work, stick with the original.

The Standard Lorem Ipsum Passage

The most commonly used Lorem Ipsum text begins with: “Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit, sed do eiusmod tempor incididunt ut labore et dolore magna aliqua. Duis aute irure dolor in reprehenderit in voluptate velit esse cillum dolore eu fugiat nulla pariatur. Excepteur sint occaecat cupidatat non proident, sunt in culpa qui officia deserunt mollit anim id est laborum.”
